How We Think
How We Think
is a book written by the American educational philosopher
John Dewey
, published in 1910.
[
1
]
It was reissued in a substantially revised edition in 1933.
[
2
]
The original version has 14 chapters and opens with the words:
No words are oftener on our lips than
thinking
and
thought
. So profuse and varied, indeed, is our use of these words that it is not easy to define just what we mean by them.
[
1
]
Chapter 1 is then concerned with establishing a "single consistent meaning" for "thinking" and "thought".
